program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),     # CS gain device
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmidc": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # NMOS cascode
    "Lc":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "vx":    (0.2, 0.12, 0.3),       # cascode source node voltage
    "Rf":    (425e3, 405e3, 600e3),
    "gmidf": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # PMOS output follower
    "Lf":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.6),
    "If2":   (14e-6, 8e-6, 18e-6),
    "cpar":  (3e-15, 1e-15, 8e-15),  # wiring parasitic at gain node (model only)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Rf = p["Rf"]; vx = p["vx"]
    I1 = iref

    # gain device, drain held at vx by the cascode
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)
    vg = m1.vgs                      # o1 DC = gate DC (no DC current in Rf)
    # cascode device
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I1, vds=max(vg - vx, 0.1), vsb=vx)
    vgc = vx + mc.vgs
    # divider for cascode gate (~0.5 uA)
    Rtot = 3.6e6
    Rbot = Rtot * vgc / VDD
    Rtop = Rtot - Rbot
    Idiv = VDD / Rtot

    # PMOS follower, bulk tied to its source, drain to vss
    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmidf"], p["Lf"], p["If2"], vds=1.0, vsb=0.0)
    vout = vg + mf.vgs
    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmidf"], p["Lf"], p["If2"], vds=max(vout, 0.3), vsb=0.0)
    vout = vg + mf.vgs
    R2 = max(VDD - vout, 0.1) / p["If2"]

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("RS", "ibias", "o1", 1.0)                 # reference current = active load
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MC", "o1", "vcb", "x", "vss", mc)
    n.R("RT", "vdd", "vcb", Rtop)
    n.R("RB", "vcb", "vss", Rbot)
    n.C("CB", "vcb", "vss", 2e-12)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "o1", Rf)
    n.dev("MF", "vss", "o1", "vout", "vout", mf)
    n.R("R2", "vdd", "vout", R2)

    # --- analytic nodal model (cascode isolates Cgd1 from o1)
    gL2 = mf.gds + 1.0 / R2
    Af = mf.gm / (mf.gm + gL2)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Co = mc.cdd + mf.cgd + max(mf.cgg - mf.cgd, 0.0) * (1 - Af) + p["cpar"]
    G1 = m1.gds * mc.gds / (mc.gm + mc.gmbs + mc.gds) + 1e-9
    gmeff = m1.gm
    f = np.logspace(4, 9.5, 3000); s = 2j * PI * f
    Cf = mc.cgd * 0.0 + 0.3e-15
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    Y11 = s * Cin + Yf; Y12 = -Yf
    Y21 = gmeff - Yf;  Y22 = G1 + s * Co + Yf
    det = Y11 * Y22 - Y12 * Y21
    vo1 = -Y21 / det
    Hf = mf.gm / (mf.gm + gL2 + s * (cl + mf.cgd))
    mag = np.abs(vo1 * Hf)
    zt = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < zt / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]

    # noise at 1 MHz
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    i_o1 = 4 * kT * ((2.0 / 3.0) * m1.gm)
    Yin = abs(1j * w * Cin + 1.0 / Rf)
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + i_o1 * (Yin / m1.gm) ** 2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = VDD * (iref + p["If2"] + Idiv)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": in_noise, "iref_used": iref}
